WITH sex_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 'MISSING'
      WHEN p.SEX = '' THEN 'BLANK'
      ELSE p.SEX
    END as sex,
    COUNT(*) as exam_count
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY CASE 
      WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 'MISSING'
      WHEN p.SEX = '' THEN 'BLANK'
      ELSE p.SEX
    END
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    sex,
    exam_count,
    exam_count * 1.0 / SUM(exam_count) OVER () as share,
    AVG(exam_count) OVER () as avg_count_per_sex
  FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT 
  SUM(exam_count) as total_of_above_avg_counts,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(exam_count - avg_count_per_sex) as avg_excess_count
FROM stats
WHERE exam_count > avg_count_per_sex
